local __LC_KEY = "h53VGMfa5GwuoMQR"
local __LC_PAYLOAD = ""
local __LC_LAYERS = {"xor", "caesar", "reverse", "base64"}

local function __lc_bxor(a, b)
  local r, m = 0, 1
  for _ = 0, 7 do
    local x, y = a % 2, b % 2
    if x ~= y then r = r + m end
    a, b, m = math.floor(a / 2), math.floor(b / 2), m * 2
  end
  return r
end

local function __lc_xor(data, key)
  local out, keyLength = {}, #key
  if keyLength == 0 then return data end
  for index = 1, #data do
    out[index] = string.char(__lc_bxor(
      string.byte(data, index),
      string.byte(key, ((index - 1) % keyLength) + 1)
    ))
  end
  return table.concat(out)
end

local function __lc_caesar_inv(data, key)
  local shift = 0
  for index = 1, #key do
    shift = (shift + string.byte(key, index)) % 256
  end
  local out = {}
  for index = 1, #data do
    out[index] = string.char((string.byte(data, index) + shift) % 256)
  end
  return table.concat(out)
end

local function __lc_reverse(data)
  return string.reverse(data)
end

local function __lc_rotate_inv(data, key)
  local amount = 0
  for index = 1, #key do
    amount = (amount + string.byte(key, index)) % math.max(#data, 1)
  end
  if #data == 0 or amount == 0 then return data end
  amount = amount % #data
  return string.sub(data, #data - amount + 1) .. string.sub(data, 1, #data - amount)
end

local __lc_b64chars = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local __lc_b64lookup = {}
for index = 1, #__lc_b64chars do
  __lc_b64lookup[string.sub(__lc_b64chars, index, index)] = index - 1
end

local function __lc_b64dec(data)
  data = string.gsub(data, "[^" .. __lc_b64chars .. "=]", "")
  local out = {}
  local buffer, bits = 0, 0
  for index = 1, #data do
    local char = string.sub(data, index, index)
    if char == "=" then break end
    local value = __lc_b64lookup[char]
    if value == nil then
      error("Invalid Base64 payload", 0)
    end
    buffer = buffer * 64 + value
    bits = bits + 6
    if bits >= 8 then
      bits = bits - 8
      local byte = math.floor(buffer / (2 ^ bits))
      buffer = buffer % (2 ^ bits)
      out[#out + 1] = string.char(byte)
    end
  end
  return table.concat(out)
end

local __lc_ops = {
  xor = function(data, key) return __lc_xor(data, key) end,
  caesar = function(data, key) return __lc_caesar_inv(data, key) end,
  reverse = function(data) return __lc_reverse(data) end,
  rotate = function(data, key) return __lc_rotate_inv(data, key) end,
  base64 = function(data) return __lc_b64dec(data) end,
}

local function __lc_decrypt(payload, key, layers)
  local data = payload
  for index = #layers, 1, -1 do
    local layer = layers[index]
    local op = __lc_ops[layer]
    if not op then
      error("Unsupported encryption layer: " .. tostring(layer), 0)
    end
    if layer == "reverse" then
      data = op(data)
    elseif layer == "base64" then
      data = op(data)
    else
      data = op(data, key)
    end
  end
  return data
end

local function __lc_b64(payload)
  local chars = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
  local lookup = {}
  for index = 1, #chars do
    lookup[string.sub(chars, index, index)] = index - 1
  end
  payload = string.gsub(payload, "[^" .. chars .. "=]", "")
  local out, buffer, bits = {}, 0, 0
  for index = 1, #payload do
    local char = string.sub(payload, index, index)
    if char == "=" then break end
    local value = lookup[char]
    if value == nil then
      error("Invalid encrypted payload", 0)
    end
    buffer = buffer * 64 + value
    bits = bits + 6
    if bits >= 8 then
      bits = bits - 8
      local byte = math.floor(buffer / (2 ^ bits))
      buffer = buffer % (2 ^ bits)
      out[#out + 1] = string.char(byte)
    end
  end
  return table.concat(out)
end

local __lc_loader = (loadstring or load)
local __lc_source = __lc_decrypt(__lc_b64(__LC_PAYLOAD), __LC_KEY, __LC_LAYERS)
local __lc_fn, __lc_err = __lc_loader(__lc_source, "@protected_script")
if not __lc_fn then
  error(__lc_err or "Failed to load protected script", 0)
end
__lc_fn()
